criteria.question: Does one impossible standing/support relationship lead the first-glance impression of the whole photograph rather than appear as an incidental prop?
criteria.pass_rule: The inverted person, overhead contact and upright-world contrast read together at thumbnail and native scale.

criteria.question: Are both shoe soles visibly attached to overhead masonry with a coherent continuous human body below them?
criteria.pass_rule: Both contact boundaries and connected body must be assessable at native scale; a nearby shoe or inferred support is insufficient.

criteria.question: Do lamppost, curb or building markers establish the normal street direction separately from the inverted body?
criteria.pass_rule: At least two clear ordinary-world direction cues coexist with the overhead figure in one image.

criteria.question: Do the supplied portrait visible face proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob and wispy fringe survive?
criteria.pass_rule: Hair and face remain visibly comparable at native scale; similarity does not establish real identity or age.

strict_qualification: all test criteria plus every managed hard gate pass; user judgment remains pending
